comments.body: CA-TX-1 fixed in draft head826bef255362b258d5dcde2100c90dc7d591edb3: an old-session partial STOP_ACK no longer clears a newer session's Stop barrier. The completion check now requires the event nonce to equal the current TX nonce. Added regression over old ACK prefix lengths; author suite now14 groups, strict C11 and ASan/UBSan pass. Root verified both remote files byte-for-byte. Supporting independent boundary tests exposed this issue after the original review; the previous no-known-defect conclusion for06b676 is superseded. Critic-A has independently verified corrected bytes locally and is rebinding to this SHA. No USB hardware, final integration or merge acceptance claimed.
